articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) (“Mawson” or the “Company”), a digital infrastructure provider, is pleased to announce that Rahul Mewawalla has been appointed as Chief Executive Officer and President of the Company.
